references.text: Jotbathah (Yotbatah) is mentioned as a place with streams that the Israelites passed through during their journey. This is the same place as Jotbathah in Numbers 33:33-34.
The previous stop on the route, where the Israelites broke camp from Hor-haggidgad and encamped at Jotbathah, which is the starting point of the journey mentioned in verse 34.
The next stop on the route, where the Israelites broke camp from Ezion-geber and encamped there. This shows the continuous travel route through the wilderness.
